test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people - N, O, P, S, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing North. N sits fourth to the right of O. Neither N nor O sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. Only one person sits between N and P. S sits third to the right of P. W sits fourth to the right of X. Who sits to the immediate right of Y?
solution:
Given: Seven people - N, O, P, S, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing North. 

1) N sits fourth to the right of O.

3) Neither N nor O sit at any of the extreme ends of the line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0821379ea40e6b7608c9073da92c6d0979dc0ac6e9f406785fc6babaed7392ba.png] 

3) Only one person sits between N and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0637fe2450af772f686109792f62d469327a29903ff78cb15c12a55e1a82833.png] 

4) S sits third to the right of P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/657b0e122763cea0015999d12f098f8852d4133419d6f9027ff36979f2efabd2.png] 

5) W sits fourth to the right of X.

As after positioning W and X only one position is left which will be occupied by the one person i.e. Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/808a18f57f53be9a58955ea60d69f70636fcfd770c15e072e1af6ce30d659065.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, P sits to the immediate right of Y.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
